title: Story Clue Crew · Q3 W12 D02
objective: Use details from a story to explain characters, events, and ideas.
introduction: Milo is watching Ben and the ants! 🐱 Use story clues to explain what happened and why. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: the person or animal in the story
where and when the story happens

activities.instruction: Listen and learn how to find story clues!
activities.content: Ben watched the ants march in a line to their home. Each ant carried a small piece of food. Ben said, 'They work together like one big family.'

feedback.retry: Find the clue in Story Clue Crew again. 💪

items.prompt: Take a good look: Who is in the story?  (in this lesson: Story Clue Crew)
items.explanation: The story is about Ben and the ants. The mailman, the cook, and the teacher are not in the story.

items.prompt: Take a good look: Where does the story happen?  (in this lesson: Story Clue Crew)
items.explanation: Ben watched the ants in the yard. The market, the school, and the beach are not in the story.

items.prompt: Take a good look: What happened in the story?  (in this lesson: Story Clue Crew)

options.text: the ants marched in a line carrying food

items.explanation: The story says the ants marched in a line carrying food. The ants did not fly home or carry stones.

items.prompt: Take a good look: Which detail is TRUE from the story?  (in this lesson: Story Clue Crew)

options.text: Each ant carried a small piece of food.

items.explanation: The story says each ant carried a small piece of food. The ants did not carry stones, Ben did not feed them bread, and they were not flying home.

items.prompt: How did Ben feel at the end of the story?
items.explanation: Ben felt amazed because the ants worked together like one big family. Hungry, angry, and sleepy do not match the end of the story.
